name: s2k_jtLoad
formula: =LAMBDA(jtName,loadPat,isGlobal,Fx,Fy,Fz,Mx,My,Mz,TEXTJOIN("   ", FALSE, "Joint=" & jtName, "LoadPat=" & loadPat, IF(isGlobal, "CoordSys=GLOBAL", "CoordSys=LOCAL"), "F1=" & Fx, "F2=" & Fy, "F3=" & Fz, "M1=" & Mx, "M2=" & My, "M3=" & Mz, ))
comment: Returns a JOINT LOADS - FORCE line joined by three spaces. Arguments: jtName, loadPat, isGlobal, Fx, Fy, Fz, Mx, My, Mz as Joint, LoadPat, CoordSys=GLOBAL if isGlobal else LOCAL, F1, F2, F3, M1, M2, M3. No error branch. Last Update at 2026-11-03.
